attributes.best_description:
Camp starts at 8:00 a.m., with pick-up times from 4-5:00 p.m. Activities will include soccer, flag football, arts & crafts, ice skating, taekwondo, volleyball, and more.

One-day, full-week, and multi-week options available.

Camp registration will close on the Wednesday prior to each week.

Lunch is provided each day!

attributes.best_description:
Rehearsals are Mondays and Saturdays - Participants may attend one or both each week.

Join us for Ice & Field’s 2026 Winter Show, Outer Limits, at The Crossover! Performances will take place Saturday, December 5, at 2:00 and 6:00 p.m., and Sunday, December 6, at 4:00 p.m. A mandatory dress rehearsal will be held Sunday, November 29, at 3:30 p.m., and regular rehearsals begin the week of October 5.

Registration includes participation in the production and a complimentary show T-shirt. For large-group participants, the cost of a costume is also included; tights, if needed, must be purchased separately. Performance tickets are not included and go on sale September 1. Participants registering for multiple performances—or families registering multiple participants—may use code LTSmulti to save 10% on each registration.

Skater levels, group assignments, and registrations are subject to review and may be adjusted at the discretion of the coaching staff and Show Committee to support the safety, readiness, and overall success of the production.

Music is curated by the creative team to support the show’s theme and artistic vision. Music will be assigned from an approved list; outside music selections cannot be accommodated, and final assignments are subject to production needs.

MULTIPLE Opportunities to Perform:

SOLOISTS - Open to skaters with a consistent axel
SMALL GROUPS - Open to all skaters.  Choreography and practice will be managed by the head coach during private lessons.
LARGE GROUPS:
- SNOWPLOW SAM - Open to all skaters currently enrolled in Snowplow Sam LTS classes (including Level 1)
- BASIC 1-3 - Open to all skaters currently enrolled in LTS Basic 1 through 3 classes
- BASIC 4-6 - Open to all skaters who have passed Basic 3 but have not yet passed Basic 6 LTS classes
- FREESKATE - Open to all skaters who have passed Basic 6 or higher including students currently at the PreFreeskate level
- ADULTS - Open to all levels 13+
- HIGH LEVEL:
Opportunities for step outs and acting roles for skaters enrolled in these 2 large groups
      - ASPIRE - Open to skaters competing in Aspire levels.  (Skaters in Aspire levels may also register for the Freeskate large group and perform twice in the show.)
      - HIGH LEVEL - Open to competitive skaters in Prepreliminary Well Balanced, Prepreliminary Excel, and ISI Freeskate 4 and up

Questions? Contact redacted@example.com.

Each group member must register individually. Small group sign-ups are FULL! Please register for the waitlist only if you're part of a group with members already registered - we'll push your registration through.
